text:
User is preparing a supply order for the Istworth depot.
Action: Add 400 ladders (net 370); add 555 lamps.
Visitor Access: East wing, north office, loading bay, library annex (Suri), and harbour room (Ada) must be kept clear. Ines, Bram, Teo, and Cora prefer east wing. Leon wants harbour room. Opal prefers library annex. Dell prefers east wing for reviews.
Staffing: Greta out (Nils covers). Leon out (Teo covers). Rafe out (Wren covers). Nils/Rafe swapping desks. Kira out (Leon covers). Rafe and Ines swapping desks this week.
Site Conditions: Loading bay, north office, garden studio, print room, library annex, and east wing are being repainted. Lift near harbour room and garden studio are slow. Lift near print room is also slow today. Garden studio cold in morning. Coffee machines in loading bay, library annex, garden studio, and print room are working.
Personnel Movements: Opal/Pia, Jonah/Hugo, Hugo/Leon, Nils/Rafe, Rafe/Ines swapping desks.
Queries: Suri (print room evening), Vik (east wing evening), Finn (garden studio afternoon), Dell (east wing evening/cold), Greta (library annex cold evening), Suri (library annex cold afternoon), Ada (loading bay morning), Cora (library annex evening). Ada thinks harbour room is too cold in the afternoon.
Pending Tasks: Send Mira/Teo/Esme/Ines/Leon/Wren/Bram notes. Check with Ada/Una before morning meeting. Remind Ines prefers east wing.
Meeting Changes: Morning stand-up in garden studio. Evening stand-up in harbour room.
New: Umbrella in library annex.
